summary: Frontend E2E re-test of /register 4-step wizard after visual-edits/babel-metadata-plugin.js line 865 null-guard fix. Both flows PASS. The plugin no longer crashes and /register renders normally. Success flow: created new tenant with random RNC 113937346, wizard completed all 4 steps, submit produced HTTP 2xx with clienteId, AuthContext.register() recognized success (via clienteId fallback), auto-login succeeded and app navigated to /dashboard as 'QA Tester' admin. No 'register-error' surfaced. Regression flow: duplicate RNC 132062884 (AXCOM SRL) reached step 4, submit surfaced 'register-error' with real backend message 'Ya existe un cliente con ese RNC' under the 'Confirma tu registro' heading, and the user remained on /register (no redirect).

e2e_flows_verified.flow: Register success (new random RNC in TEST env)
e2e_flows_verified.notes: Auto-login after register worked. QA Tester admin dashboard rendered with company 'Test Empresa QA' RNC 113937346.

e2e_flows_verified.error_shown: Ya existe un cliente con ese RNC
e2e_flows_verified.notes: register-error visible under 'Confirma tu registro', stayed on /register, no redirect. Backend error message surfaced through data.message per AuthContext.register() failure branch.

critical_code_review_comments: babel-metadata-plugin.js L865 null-guard (searchScope + typeof searchScope.traverse === 'function') is defensive and correct — prevents the previous 'Cannot read properties of null (reading traverse)' crash without changing plugin behavior.
AuthContext.register() properly handles both response shapes (success:true wrapper AND raw tenantId/clienteId). Verified end-to-end in preview env.
Minor (already flagged in iteration_3): proxy returns 'clienteId' while direct .NET returns 'tenantId'. Frontend fallback covers both — consider unifying server-side.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new tenant in TEST env (RNC 113937346, company 'Test Empresa QA', user qa-user-dg1tic@test.com / password A123@qwerty). Duplicate-RNC attempt did NOT create a new tenant (backend rejected). No cleanup performed — no delete endpoint reachable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both the register bug (auto-recognize success via clienteId/tenantId) AND the visual-edits plugin crash (null parentPath) are now resolved and verified end-to-end. /register renders, all 4 steps advance, submit succeeds on new RNC and shows real backend error on duplicate. No further re-test required for this bug pair.
rca_of_the_issue: Two independent bugs converged: (1) AuthContext.register() only accepted data.success===true, but production/.NET returns raw {tenantId,...} on HTTP 200 without a success flag — fixed by treating HTTP 2xx + presence of tenantId/clienteId as success; (2) visual-edits babel plugin crashed on ImportDeclaration when importPath.parentPath was null, blocking bundle compilation — fixed by null-guarding searchScope at L865-866. With both fixes verified live, users can now register successfully AND see real duplicate-RNC error messages.
